course.title: Mathematics degree | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: Bachelor of Mathematics in one of 16 majors
Apply to Mathematics and choose one of the majors listed above at the end of first year.
The Admission Information Form is required for admission.
Faculty of Mathematics

reg.title: Regular system of study | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: In the regular system of study, you'll be in school between September and April each year and have your summers free to work, travel, and pursue your interests outside of school.
Finish your degree in four years, instead of five years as in co-op.

uk.title: Mathematics (includes 16 majors) admission requirements for British System (A Levels) high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: A Level Mathematics, minimum final grade of A
Two other academic A Level courses, minimum final grade of A in each
English at either the GCSE, AS, or A Level
Passes in at least five unique subjects, three of which must be at the Advanced Level

ib.title: Mathematics (includes 16 majors) admission requirements for International Baccalaureate (IB) high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches, minimum 6; HL or SL English A. Total 30. The Admission Information Form is required for admission to this program.
IB diploma required with six total IB courses; at least three must be HL.
Total scores exclude diploma points.

us.title: Mathematics (includes 16 majors) admission requirements for American (US) system high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: AP Calculus, minimum final grade of 4.
Algebra (Pre-Calculus).
Grade 12 English.
Minimum overall Grade 12 average: 88%.
SAT and ACT test scores are not required for admission.

Mathematics (Faculty of Mathematics): IB Diploma (six courses, at least three HL) with HL Maths Analysis and Approaches (minimum 6) and English A (HL or SL); total 30, excluding diploma points. Admission Information Form required.
